rubric.label: Product sits in TVF's lanes: creator tools, media-tech, short-form video, audience analytics, localisation
rubric.guidance: Full credit when the product is something TVF's studio or platform would use or bundle tomorrow; half for adjacent (general video tooling, ad-tech for creators). STRONGEST signal.

rubric.label: Real traction: paying customers, named creator/studio clients, or public usage numbers
rubric.guidance: Press-quoted revenue, customer counts, or logo walls of creators/studios. A launch post alone is 0.

rubric.label: Right size for an acqui-hire or tuck-in: ~3-25 people, pre-Series B
rubric.guidance: Team page headcount plus funding stage. Bigger than 25 or past Series B is a different conversation.

rubric.label: Signals of openness: bridge round, 'exploring strategic options', founder departures, stalled hiring
rubric.guidance: Full credit for explicit strategic-options language in press or a founder post; half for indirect signals (layoffs, long funding gap).

rubric.label: Named founder/CEO identified and reachable
rubric.guidance: 1.0 named founder with a real mailbox; 0.5 role inbox; 0 nothing reachable.

rubric.label: Relevance to India: Indian market presence, Indic-language support, or a diaspora founder
rubric.guidance: Full credit for an India office, Indian customers, or Indic localisation; half for a stated India roadmap.

score_modifiers.label: PENALTY: total raised beyond what a tuck-in can absorb
score_modifiers.guidance: Scaled by how far past the cap the last disclosed raise sits. Set only on published funding data.

score_modifiers.label: PENALTY: product competes with, rather than complements, TVF's own platform
score_modifiers.guidance: A rival streaming/studio play is a conflict; a tool TVF would buy is not.

gates.label: HQ in the United States or India
gates.guidance: Fires ONLY on confirmed HQ outside US/India. Blank passes.

gates.label: Exclude public companies, units of majors, and anything clearly past tuck-in size
gates.guidance: Public listing, a corporate parent, or a confirmed >100 headcount. Blank passes.

gates.label: Must have a website or product page
Company must be operating, not shut down
gates.guidance: Fires ONLY on a confirmed shutdown notice or 12+ months of silence. Blank passes.

review_checklist.label: Is this a product company with its own technology, not an agency, a consultancy, or a media brand?
Would this be a tuck-in or acqui-hire TVF could actually close, not a fundraise-stage negotiation?
Are the founders people TVF would want to keep, and is that visible from what they have built?

news_rss_discovery_queries.query: "media tech" startup India OR "Indian founders" raises

x_intent_discovery_queries.query: "looking for a strategic partner" creator tools

wikidata_discovery.guidance: Q1058914 software company, Q18388277 technology company; US-filtered like Segment 1. Notable-only again, so expect a seed skewed large; the not_a_major gate and right_size do the trimming.

sources.name: Google News RSS (funding + strategic-options headlines)
sources.detail: Same connector as Segment 1, different queries. A funding or strategic-options headline naming the company is the primary discovery path.

sources.name: Wikidata SPARQL
sources.detail: US software/technology companies with a website. Seed, not stream.

sources.name: YouTube Data API v3
sources.detail: Product demo channels. Low expected yield; kept for parity.

sources.name: X intent posts via Google News RSS

self_exclusion.guidance: Same affiliates as Segment 1 must never enter this pool either.

enrichment.guidance: Startups publish founders on /team and /about far more reliably than production shops publish EPs, so the site-scrape path is primary here, not a fallback.

sender.name: SET_ME
sender.title: Corporate Development, The Viral Fever
sender.postal_address: SET_ME street address for the email footer (CAN-SPAM)
sender.guidance: Set before the first send. Gmail address comes from GMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS in .env.

templates.subject: {{company}} + The Viral Fever — a conversation worth having
templates.guidance: First touch. Deliberately ambiguous about acquisition - founders hear 'strategic' and choose how to read it. Human-approved per draft like every template.

outreach.guidance: Identical pipeline to Segment 1: drafted -> human-approved -> sent, one touch per company enforced by the database. The footer -- sign-off, postal address, opt-out -- is one setting for the whole segment (outreach.footer.text), edited in the app under Outreach -> Footer; templates end with {{footer}}.

footer.guidance: The last block of every email in this segment. Edited in the app: Outreach -> Footer. It may use {{sender_name}}, {{sender_title}}, {{sender_email}}, {{postal_address}}, {{company}} and {{greeting_name}}, and it is refused unless it carries a postal address and a way out -- both are required of commercial email and both are what keep a sending domain alive. Templates end with {{footer}}; see tools/draft_render.py.
